svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 📊 Numbers you can compare later / 📌 Pinned to a digest, not a tag / 📦 Defining the answer once / ⛓️ A gate that cannot drift / 🪞 Review before a release / 🪄 No hidden state in the path / 🔍 Metrics you can actually read / 🔬 Claims that survive review / 🛟 A way back when the fix is slow / 📐 One shape with nothing hidden / 📉 One fewer decision to get wrong / ⏱️ Tests in under a coffee
